title: Digital billboard slot as a service
hypothesis: People and small businesses will pay for a permanent or time-bounded claim on a visible digital property surface.
target_buyer: Creators, small businesses, collectors, and internet-native projects wanting durable attention.
smallest_test: Sell one clearly bounded NZ$29-NZ$99 digital billboard slot with a defined placement, duration, and proof of publication.
kill_condition: No qualified buyer interest after 20 targeted exposures, or fulfilment cannot be proven deterministically.
